  CYCLIC CONTROL LOGIC EXECUTION ROUTINE (SAMPLE PERIOD Ts = 20 ms / 50 Hz)
========================================================================================================================
*)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 0: SIL-3 / SIL-4 HARDWARE SAFETY CHAIN & IMMEDIATE DE-ENERGIZATION TRIPS
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Verify dual-channel hardware safety loop integrity *)
IF NOT bEStopSafetyRelayOk THEN
    (* Immediate failsafe lock: neutral servo spool, isolate accumulators, lock hydraulic circuit *)
    rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 0.0;
    rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 0.0;
    bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := FALSE;
    bWedgeLockEngageCmd             := TRUE;  (* Fail-as-is mechanical wedge dog spring lock *)
    bPackerGelInjectionCmd          := FALSE;
    bAcousticTxEnable               := TRUE;
    dwAcousticTxPayload             := 16#DEADF001; (* Emergency Stop Trip Code *)

    wDiagnosticFaultWord.0          := TRUE;  (* E-Stop Trip Active *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0            := TRUE;  (* Severity: Emergency *)
    bSystemAlarm                    := TRUE;
    wSystemStatusWord               := 16#F000;
    iCurrentState                   := 999;   (* Jump immediately to Failsafe Shutdown *)
    iActiveSequenceState            := 999;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Autonomous Deadman / Autoshear Disconnect Trigger (Umbilical parted or LMRP separation) *)
IF bEmergencyAutoshearTrigger AND (iCurrentState < 50) THEN
    (* Riser severance detected: initiate immediate full-power autonomous cut bypass *)
    bAutoshearArmed                 := TRUE;
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0            := TRUE;  (* Emergency Severity *)
    wSystemStatusWord.14            := TRUE;  (* Autoshear Engaged *)
    iCurrentState                   := 950;   (* Jump to Autonomous Deadman Autoshear Routine *)
END_IF;

(* Extreme Wellbore Overpressure Trip: Annular well pressure exceeding rating *)
IF (rBOPWellborePressure_bar > 1034.0) THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.15         := TRUE;  (* Wellbore Extreme Overpressure Alarm *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0            := TRUE;
    bSystemAlarm                    := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 1: DEEPWATER HYDROSTATIC PRESSURE COMPENSATION, THERMAL PROPERTIES & OCEAN ACOUSTIC PROPAGATION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute dynamic seawater density at depth and abyssal temperature:
   rho_sw(T, S, P) = rho_0(S, T) / (1 - P / K(S, T, P))
   Using simplified high-accuracy industrial polynomial for subsea BOP controls: *)
rCalculatedSeawaterDensity_kgm3 := 1027.0
    + (0.0045 * rSubseaWaterDepth_m)
    - (0.0650 * (rSeawaterTemperature_degC - 4.0))
    + (0.7500 * (c_rSeawaterSalinityRef_PSU - 35.0));

(* Limit seawater density to realistic oceanic envelope (1020 .. 1045 kg/m^3) *)
IF rCalculatedSeawaterDensity_kgm3 < 1020.0 THEN
    rCalculatedSeawaterDensity_kgm3 := 1020.0;
ELSIF rCalculatedSeawaterDensity_kgm3 > 1045.0 THEN
    rCalculatedSeawaterDensity_kgm3 := 1045.0;
END_IF;

(* Theoretical hydrostatic pressure at wellhead datum: P = rho * g * h * 10^-5 bar *)
rTheoreticalHydrostaticPress_bar := (rCalculatedSeawaterDensity_kgm3 * c_rGravityRef_mps2 * rSubseaWaterDepth_m) * 1.0E-5;

(* Verify ambient hydrostatic sensor plausibility against theoretical head *)
IF ABS(rAmbientHydrostaticPress_bar - rTheoreticalHydrostaticPress_bar) > 25.0 THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.1 := TRUE; (* Hydrostatic Transducer Divergence Alarm *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE; (* Severity: High *)
    bSystemAlarm           := TRUE;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.1 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Hydrostatic Reservoir Return Compensator Evaluation:
   The compensator bladder must maintain +1.50 bar over ambient hydrostatic to prevent seawater intrusion *)
rCompensatorBiasError_bar := rReservoirCompensatorPress_bar - (rAmbientHydrostaticPress_bar + 1.50);

IF (rCompensatorBiasError_bar < -1.00) THEN
    (* Severe risk of seawater ingress into hydraulic fluid *)
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.2 := TRUE; (* Reservoir Under-Pressure Fault *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0   := TRUE; (* Severity: Emergency *)
    bSystemAlarm           := TRUE;
    bHydrostaticEquilibrated := FALSE;
ELSIF (rCompensatorBiasError_bar > 12.0) THEN
    (* Excessive backpressure reduces actuator shearing force capability *)
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.3 := TRUE; (* Reservoir Over-Pressure Fault *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE; (* Severity: High *)
    bSystemAlarm           := TRUE;
    bHydrostaticEquilibrated := FALSE;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.2 := FALSE;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.3 := FALSE;
    bHydrostaticEquilibrated := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Hydraulic Fluid Bulk Modulus (Beta_eff) calculation taking pressure and temperature into account:
   Beta_eff(P, T) = Beta_0 + (10.5 * P) - (45.0 * (T - 20.0)) *)
rFluidEffectiveBulkModulus_bar := c_rBaseFluidBulkModulus_bar
    + (10.5 * rAccumulatorSupplyPressure_bar)
    - (45.0 * (rHydraulicFluidTemp_degC - 20.0));

IF rFluidEffectiveBulkModulus_bar < 12000.0 THEN
    rFluidEffectiveBulkModulus_bar := 12000.0;
ELSIF rFluidEffectiveBulkModulus_bar > 25000.0 THEN
    rFluidEffectiveBulkModulus_bar := 25000.0;
END_IF;

(* Hydraulic Fluid Temperature Monitoring *)
IF (rHydraulicFluidTemp_degC > 65.0) THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.12 := TRUE; (* Hydraulic Fluid Overheating Alarm *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE;
    bSystemAlarm           := TRUE;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.12 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Calculate net effective differential driving pressure available to the cylinder *)
rEffectiveDiffPress_bar := rAccumulatorSupplyPressure_bar - rReservoirCompensatorPress_bar;
rAvailableDifferentialHead_bar := rEffectiveDiffPress_bar;

(* Validate subsea accumulator charge capacity (API Standard 53 minimum) *)
IF (rAccumulatorSupplyPressure_bar < c_rMinAccumulatorCharge_bar) AND (NOT bROVHotStabConnected) THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.4 := TRUE; (* Accumulator Bank Pressure Depleted Alarm *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0   := TRUE; (* Severity: Emergency *)
    bSystemAlarm           := TRUE;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.4 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Real-Time Hydraulic Volumetric Leakage Estimation:
   Q_leakage = Q_measured - (A_head * v_ram * 60,000 L/min) *)
rTheoreticalPistonFlow_Lmin := c_rPistonAreaHead_m2 * rRamLinearVelocity_mps * 60000.0;
IF (rHydraulicActuationFlow_Lmin > rTheoreticalPistonFlow_Lmin) AND (iCurrentState >= 30) AND (iCurrentState <= 60) THEN
    rVolumetricLeakageRate_Lmin := rHydraulicActuationFlow_Lmin - rTheoreticalPistonFlow_Lmin;
    IF (rVolumetricLeakageRate_Lmin > 180.0) THEN
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.11 := TRUE; (* High Volumetric Leakage Bypass Fault *)
        wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE;
        bSystemAlarm           := TRUE;
    ELSE
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.11 := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVolumetricLeakageRate_Lmin := 0.0;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.11     := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Rod-End Cavitation Floor Assessment: P_rod must exceed hydrostatic pressure + 2.0 bar *)
IF (aStateVector[4] < (rAmbientHydrostaticPress_bar + 2.0)) AND (iCurrentState >= 30) AND (iCurrentState <= 60) THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.13 := TRUE; (* Cavitation Warning on Rod Chamber *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.2    := TRUE;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.13 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Mackenzie (1981) 9-Term Oceanographic Sound Speed Formulation in Deepwater:
   c(T, S, D) = 1448.96 + 4.591*T - 5.304E-2*T^2 + 2.374E-4*T^3
              + 1.340*(S - 35) + 1.630E-2*D + 1.675E-7*D^2 - 1.025E-2*T*(S - 35) - 7.139E-13*T*D^3 *)
rDeepwaterSoundSpeed_mps := 1448.96
    + (4.591 * rSeawaterTemperature_degC)
    - (0.05304 * rSeawaterTemperature_degC * rSeawaterTemperature_degC)
    + (0.0002374 * rSeawaterTemperature_degC * rSeawaterTemperature_degC * rSeawaterTemperature_degC)
    + (1.340 * (c_rSeawaterSalinityRef_PSU - 35.0))
    + (0.01630 * rSubseaWaterDepth_m)
    + (1.675E-7 * rSubseaWaterDepth_m * rSubseaWaterDepth_m)
    - (0.01025 * rSeawaterTemperature_degC * (c_rSeawaterSalinityRef_PSU - 35.0))
    - (7.139E-13 * rSeawaterTemperature_degC * rSubseaWaterDepth_m * rSubseaWaterDepth_m * rSubseaWaterDepth_m);

(* Thorpe Empirical Seawater Acoustic Attenuation Coefficient at Carrier Frequency f [kHz]:
   alpha(f) = (0.11 * f^2) / (1 + f^2) + (44 * f^2) / (4100 + f^2) + 2.75E-4 * f^2 + 0.003  [dB/km] *)
IF (rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz > 1.0) AND (rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz < 100.0) THEN
    rAcousticThorpeAtten_dB_km := ((0.11 * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz) / (1.0 + (rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz)))
        + ((44.0 * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz) / (4100.0 + (rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz)))
        + (0.000275 * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz * rAcousticCarrierFreq_kHz)
        + 0.0030;
ELSE
    rAcousticThorpeAtten_dB_km := 1.850; (* Default attenuation at 18.5 kHz in cold seawater *)
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 2: ACOUSTIC TELEMETRY TRANSCEIVER TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) ENGINE
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Channel Validity Assessment based on hardware CRC, packet lock, SNR threshold (12.0 dB), and Doppler limit *)
bModemA_Trusted := bAcousticPktValid_ModemA AND (rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB >= 12.0) AND (ABS(rAcousticDopplerShiftA_Hz) <= 18.0);
bModemB_Trusted := bAcousticPktValid_ModemB AND (rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB >= 12.0) AND (ABS(rAcousticDopplerShiftB_Hz) <= 18.0);
bModemC_Trusted := bAcousticPktValid_ModemC AND (rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB >= 12.0) AND (ABS(rAcousticDopplerShiftC_Hz) <= 18.0);

(* Count healthy receiving transducers *)
iHealthyModemCount := 0;
IF bModemA_Trusted THEN iHealthyModemCount := iHealthyModemCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bModemB_Trusted THEN iHealthyModemCount := iHealthyModemCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bModemC_Trusted THEN iHealthyModemCount := iHealthyModemCount + 1; END_IF;

(* Dynamic SNR Weighted Beamforming Calculation *)
rSumSNR := 0.0;
IF bModemA_Trusted THEN rSumSNR := rSumSNR + rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB; END_IF;
IF bModemB_Trusted THEN rSumSNR := rSumSNR + rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB; END_IF;
IF bModemC_Trusted THEN rSumSNR := rSumSNR + rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB; END_IF;

IF (rSumSNR > 1.0) THEN
    IF bModemA_Trusted THEN rWeightModemA := rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB / rSumSNR; ELSE rWeightModemA := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF bModemB_Trusted THEN rWeightModemB := rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB / rSumSNR; ELSE rWeightModemB := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF bModemC_Trusted THEN rWeightModemC := rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB / rSumSNR; ELSE rWeightModemC := 0.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rWeightModemA := 0.3333;
    rWeightModemB := 0.3333;
    rWeightModemC := 0.3333;
END_IF;

(* Bitwise Consensus Voting Logic *)
IF (iHealthyModemCount = 3) THEN
    (* Full 3-Channel Transceiver Consensus Evaluation *)
    IF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemA = dwAcousticPacket_ModemB) AND (dwAcousticPacket_ModemB = dwAcousticPacket_ModemC) THEN
        dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemA;
        bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
        bDegradedTMRActive := FALSE;
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.5 := FALSE; (* Acoustic TMR Discrepancy Clear *)
        rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB * rWeightModemA)
                      + (rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB * rWeightModemB)
                      + (rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB * rWeightModemC);

    ELSIF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemA = dwAcousticPacket_ModemB) THEN
        (* Channel C Discrepant: Quarantine Channel C *)
        dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemA;
        bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        iModemQuarantineCounterC := iModemQuarantineCounterC + 1;
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.5 := TRUE;
        wAlarmSeverityWord.2   := TRUE; (* Severity: Medium *)
        rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB + rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB) * 0.5;

    ELSIF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemB = dwAcousticPacket_ModemC) THEN
        (* Channel A Discrepant: Quarantine Channel A *)
        dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemB;
        bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        iModemQuarantineCounterA := iModemQuarantineCounterA + 1;
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.5 := TRUE;
        wAlarmSeverityWord.2   := TRUE;
        rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB + rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB) * 0.5;

    ELSIF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemA = dwAcousticPacket_ModemC) THEN
        (* Channel B Discrepant: Quarantine Channel B *)
        dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemA;
        bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        iModemQuarantineCounterB := iModemQuarantineCounterB + 1;
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.5 := TRUE;
        wAlarmSeverityWord.2   := TRUE;
        rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB + rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB) * 0.5;

    ELSE
        (* Total TMR Asynchrony / Spurious Plume Noise: No two channels match *)
        dwConsensusPacket := 16#00000000;
        bVoteQuorumAchieved := FALSE;
        bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.5 := TRUE;
        wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE; (* Severity: High *)
        rVotedSNR_dB := 0.0;
    END_IF;

ELSIF (iHealthyModemCount = 2) THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Voting Mode *)
    bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.5 := TRUE;
    wAlarmSeverityWord.2   := TRUE;

    IF bModemA_Trusted AND bModemB_Trusted THEN
        IF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemA = dwAcousticPacket_ModemB) THEN
            dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemA;
            bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
            rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB + rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB) * 0.5;
        ELSE
            bVoteQuorumAchieved := FALSE;
            dwConsensusPacket := 16#00000000;
        END_IF;

    ELSIF bModemB_Trusted AND bModemC_Trusted THEN
        IF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemB = dwAcousticPacket_ModemC) THEN
            dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemB;
            bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
            rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemB_dB + rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB) * 0.5;
        ELSE
            bVoteQuorumAchieved := FALSE;
            dwConsensusPacket := 16#00000000;
        END_IF;

    ELSIF bModemA_Trusted AND bModemC_Trusted THEN
        IF (dwAcousticPacket_ModemA = dwAcousticPacket_ModemC) THEN
            dwConsensusPacket := dwAcousticPacket_ModemA;
            bVoteQuorumAchieved := TRUE;
            rVotedSNR_dB := (rAcousticSNR_ModemA_dB + rAcousticSNR_ModemC_dB) * 0.5;
        ELSE
            bVoteQuorumAchieved := FALSE;
            dwConsensusPacket := 16#00000000;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

ELSIF (iHealthyModemCount = 1) THEN
    (* Severe Acoustic Degradation: Single surviving modem *)
    bDegradedTMRActive := TRUE;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.6 := TRUE; (* Severe Acoustic Telemetry Loss *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE; (* Severity: High *)
    bVoteQuorumAchieved := FALSE;    (* Single channel cannot command safety-critical shear alone *)
    dwConsensusPacket := 16#00000000;

ELSE
    (* Total Acoustic Link Loss: Multipath plume attenuation / transducer damage *)
    bDegradedTMRActive := FALSE;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.6 := TRUE;
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0   := TRUE; (* Severity: Emergency *)
    bVoteQuorumAchieved := FALSE;
    dwConsensusPacket := 16#00000000;
    rVotedSNR_dB := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Acoustic Command Demultiplexing & Decryption *)
IF bVoteQuorumAchieved THEN
    (* Verify 16-bit Security Authentication Key *)
    IF ((dwConsensusPacket AND 16#FFFF0000) = c_dwAuthKeyMask) THEN
        (* Check Subcommands *)
        IF ((dwConsensusPacket AND 16#0000FFFF) = c_dwArmSubcommand) THEN
            bAcousticArmedSignal := TRUE;
            bAcousticCutSignal   := FALSE;
        ELSIF ((dwConsensusPacket AND 16#0000FFFF) = c_dwCutSubcommand) THEN
            bAcousticCutSignal   := TRUE;
        ELSE
            bAcousticArmedSignal := FALSE;
            bAcousticCutSignal   := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        bAcousticArmedSignal := FALSE;
        bAcousticCutSignal   := FALSE;
        wDiagnosticFaultWord.7 := TRUE; (* Invalid Acoustic Security Key *)
        wAlarmSeverityWord.1   := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bAcousticArmedSignal := FALSE;
    bAcousticCutSignal   := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Acoustic Loss Watchdog Timer *)
tAcousticLossWatchdog(IN := (iHealthyModemCount < 2), PT := T#45S);
IF tAcousticLossWatchdog.Q AND (NOT bROVHotStabConnected) THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord.8 := TRUE; (* Acoustic Telemetry Blackout Alarm *)
    wAlarmSeverityWord.0   := TRUE; (* Severity: Emergency *)
    bSystemAlarm := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: 4TH-ORDER HYDRAULIC OBSERVER & KINEMATICS STATE RECONSTRUCTION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Update State Vector from Calibrated Transducers *)
aStateVector[1] := rRamPosition_m;
aStateVector[2] := rRamLinearVelocity_mps;
aStateVector[3] := rAccumulatorSupplyPressure_bar;
aStateVector[4] := rReservoirCompensatorPress_bar;

(* State Observer Innovation Correction: x_hat(k) = A*x_hat(k-1) + B*u(k-1) + L*(y(k) - C*x_hat(k-1)) *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    aStateError[iRow] := aStateVector[iRow] - aStatePredicted[iRow];
END_FOR;

FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    aStatePredicted[iRow] := 0.0;
    (* State transition multiplication: A * x *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        aStatePredicted[iRow] := aStatePredicted[iRow] + (aMatrixA[iRow, iCol] * aStateVector[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    (* Input coupling multiplication: B * u *)
    aStatePredicted[iRow] := aStatePredicted[iRow]
        + (aMatrixB[iRow, 1] * (rCmdServoValveSpool_pct / 100.0))
        + (aMatrixB[iRow, 2] * (rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct / 100.0));
    (* Observer correction *)
    aStatePredicted[iRow] := aStatePredicted[iRow] + (aStateObserverGain_L[iRow] * aStateError[iRow]);
END_FOR;

(* Dynamic Actuator Thrust Calculation: F = (P_head * A_head - P_rod * A_rod) * 100 kN *)
rVotedRamThrust_kN := ((aStateVector[3] * c_rPistonAreaHead_m2) - (aStateVector[4] * c_rPistonAreaRod_m2)) * 100.0;

(* Force Derivative Calculation for Shear Inflection Detection *)
rIncrementalStroke_m := rRamPosition_m - rPrevRamPosition_m;
rPrevRamPosition_m   := rRamPosition_m;

IF (c_rNominalSamplingTime_s > 0.0) THEN
    rForceDerivative_kNps := (rVotedRamThrust_kN - rPrevThrustForce_kN) / c_rNominalSamplingTime_s;
    rPrevThrustForce_kN   := rVotedRamThrust_kN;
    (* First-order digital low-pass filtering on force derivative (tau = 60 ms) *)
    rFilteredForceDerivative_kNps := (0.25 * rForceDerivative_kNps) + (0.75 * rFilteredForceDerivative_kNps);
END_IF;

(* Real-Time Mechanical Cutting Energy Integration: E = Integral [ F_thrust * dx ] *)
IF (rIncrementalStroke_m > 0.0) AND (iCurrentState >= 40) AND (iCurrentState <= 60) THEN
    rAccumulatedShearEnergy_kJ := rAccumulatedShearEnergy_kJ + (rVotedRamThrust_kN * rIncrementalStroke_m);
    rMechanicalShearWork_kJ    := rAccumulatedShearEnergy_kJ;
END_IF;

(* Instantaneous Estimated Pipe Resistance: R_pipe = F_thrust - M_eff * dv/dt - F_wellbore *)
rCalculatedPipeResistance_kN := rVotedRamThrust_kN - (4.250 * (aStateVector[2] / c_rNominalSamplingTime_s))
                                - (rBOPWellborePressure_bar * 0.0275);
IF rCalculatedPipeResistance_kN < 0.0 THEN
    rCalculatedPipeResistance_kN := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Track Peak Observed Cutting Force *)
IF (rVotedRamThrust_kN > rShearPeakForceObserved_kN) AND (iCurrentState >= 40) THEN
    rShearPeakForceObserved_kN := rVotedRamThrust_kN;
END_IF;

(* Detect Physical Drill Pipe Engagement & Shear Rupture *)
IF (rRamPosition_m >= c_rWellboreClearanceEnd_m) AND (rFilteredForceDerivative_kNps > 1500.0) THEN
    bPipeContactDetected := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Shear Rupture occurs when force derivative drops severely after high thrust plateau *)
IF bPipeContactDetected AND (rShearPeakForceObserved_kN > 3500.0) AND (rFilteredForceDerivative_kNps < -4500.0) THEN
    bShearBreakthroughDetected := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST OPTIMIZATION KERNEL
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Evaluate State Tracking Errors relative to Active Phase Reference Targets *)
rGradientValve := 0.0;
rGradientBoost := 0.0;

(* Quadratic Performance Index: J = e_x^T * Q * e_x + u^T * R * u + Delta_u^T * S * Delta_u *)
rCostFunctionJ := (aDiagWeightQ[1] * (aStateVector[1] - rTargetTrajectoryPos_m) * (aStateVector[1] - rTargetTrajectoryPos_m))
                + (aDiagWeightQ[2] * (aStateVector[2] - rTargetTrajectoryVel_mps) * (aStateVector[2] - rTargetTrajectoryVel_mps))
                + (aDiagWeightQ[3] * (aStateVector[3] - rTargetHeadPressure_bar) * (aStateVector[3] - rTargetHeadPressure_bar))
                + (aDiagWeightR[1] * (rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct / 100.0) * (rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct / 100.0))
                + (aDiagWeightR[2] * (rPrevBoostCmd_pct / 100.0) * (rPrevBoostCmd_pct / 100.0));

(* Compute Analytical Gradients along 5-Step Prediction Horizon *)
FOR iHorizonStep := 1 TO 5 DO
    (* Position error gradient contribution *)
    rGradientValve := rGradientValve + (aDiagWeightQ[1] * (aStatePredicted[1] - rTargetTrajectoryPos_m) * aMatrixB[1, 1]);
    (* Velocity tracking gradient contribution *)
    rGradientValve := rGradientValve + (aDiagWeightQ[2] * (aStatePredicted[2] - rTargetTrajectoryVel_mps) * aMatrixB[2, 1]);
    (* Pressure gradient contribution for booster intensification *)
    rGradientBoost := rGradientBoost + (aDiagWeightQ[3] * (aStatePredicted[3] - rTargetHeadPressure_bar) * aMatrixB[3, 2]);
END_FOR;

(* Regularization and Slew Rate Damping *)
rGradientValve := rGradientValve + (aDiagWeightR[1] * (rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct / 100.0))
                + (aDiagWeightS[1] * ((rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct - rCmdServoValveSpool_pct) / 100.0));
rGradientBoost := rGradientBoost + (aDiagWeightR[2] * (rPrevBoostCmd_pct / 100.0))
                + (aDiagWeightS[2] * ((rPrevBoostCmd_pct - rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct) / 100.0));

(* Pre-calculate Diagonal Inverse Hessian Approximation: H_diag = B^T * Q * B + R + S *)
aHessianDiagonalInv[1] := 1.0 / ( (aMatrixB[1, 1] * aMatrixB[1, 1] * aDiagWeightQ[1])
                                + (aMatrixB[2, 1] * aMatrixB[2, 1] * aDiagWeightQ[2])
                                + aDiagWeightR[1] + aDiagWeightS[1] + 0.050 );

aHessianDiagonalInv[2] := 1.0 / ( (aMatrixB[3, 2] * aMatrixB[3, 2] * aDiagWeightQ[3])
                                + aDiagWeightR[2] + aDiagWeightS[2] + 0.050 );

(* Iterative Projected Newton-Gradient Descent Optimization (4 internal iterations per cycle) *)
rOptimalDeltaValve := rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct;
rOptimalDeltaBoost := rPrevBoostCmd_pct;

FOR iOptStep := 1 TO 4 DO
    rOptimalDeltaValve := rOptimalDeltaValve - (aHessianDiagonalInv[1] * rGradientValve * 12.50);
    rOptimalDeltaBoost := rOptimalDeltaBoost - (aHessianDiagonalInv[2] * rGradientBoost * 10.00);

    (* Enforce Slew Rate Clamping (|Delta_u| <= 25.0% per 20 ms to prevent water hammer) *)
    IF (rOptimalDeltaValve - rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct) > 25.0 THEN
        rOptimalDeltaValve := rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct + 25.0;
    ELSIF (rOptimalDeltaValve - rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct) < -25.0 THEN
        rOptimalDeltaValve := rPrevValveSpoolCmd_pct - 25.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Enforce Actuator Saturation Constraints *)
    IF rOptimalDeltaValve > 100.0 THEN
        rOptimalDeltaValve := 100.0;
    ELSIF rOptimalDeltaValve < -100.0 THEN
        rOptimalDeltaValve := -100.0;
    END_IF;

    IF rOptimalDeltaBoost > 100.0 THEN
        rOptimalDeltaBoost := 100.0;
    ELSIF rOptimalDeltaBoost < 0.0 THEN
        rOptimalDeltaBoost := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 5: SEQUENTIAL FINITE STATE MACHINE (BOP SHEAR RAM EXECUTION PHASES)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iCurrentState OF

    0: (* STATE_STANDBY_IDLE_MONITORING: Passive monitoring, hydro balance check, acoustic ping *)
        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 0.0;
        rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 0.0;
        bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := FALSE;
        bWedgeLockEngageCmd             := FALSE;
        bPackerGelInjectionCmd          := FALSE;
        bRamSealedAndLocked             := FALSE;
        bPipeContactDetected            := FALSE;
        bShearBreakthroughDetected      := FALSE;
        bWedgeLockConfirmed             := FALSE;
        rShearPeakForceObserved_kN      := 0.0;
        rAccumulatedShearEnergy_kJ      := 0.0;
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#0001; (* Bit 0: System Ready / Idle *)

        (* Acoustic Transceiver Periodic Telemetry Broadcast (Every 5 seconds) *)
        tStatePhaseTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5S);
        IF tStatePhaseTimer.Q THEN
            tStatePhaseTimer(IN := FALSE);

            dwAcousticTxPayload := 16#10010000 OR WORD_TO_DWORD(wSystemStatusWord);
        ELSE

        IF bMasterSystemEnable AND bEStopSafetyRelayOk AND (wDiagnosticFaultWord = 0) THEN

            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 0.0;

        bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := FALSE;
        bWedgeLockEngageCmd             := FALSE;

        tStatePhaseTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#60S);

        ELSIF tStatePhaseTimer.Q THEN
            tStatePhaseTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iCurrentState := 0;  (* Disarm timeout back to standby *)
        END_IF;

        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 15.0;

        bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := FALSE;
        bWedgeLockEngageCmd             := FALSE;

        END_IF;

        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#000F; (* Bit 3: Rapid Traverse Active *)

        rTargetTrajectoryVel_mps        := 0.250; (* High velocity traverse (250 mm/s) *)
        rTargetHeadPressure_bar         := rAccumulatorSupplyPressure_bar * 0.85;

        IF (rRamPosition_m >= (c_rWellboreClearanceEnd_m - 0.025)) OR bPipeContactDetected THEN

        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#001F; (* Bit 4: Impact Deceleration *)

        ELSIF tSafetyWatchdog.Q THEN

            wDiagnosticFaultWord.9      := TRUE; (* Shear Cut Stall / Timeout Fault *)

        rTargetTrajectoryVel_mps        := 0.015;
        rTargetHeadPressure_bar         := 280.0;

        bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := FALSE;
        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 20.0;
        rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 0.0;

        END_IF;

        rTargetTrajectoryPos_m          := c_rFullSealLockPosition_m;

        IF (rBOPWellborePressure_bar > 350.0) THEN

        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#01FF; (* Bit 8: Locking Dogs Engaged *)
        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 30.0;    (* Maintain forward thrust during lock engagement *)
        rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 50.0;
        bWedgeLockEngageCmd             := TRUE;    (* Energize mechanical wedge-lock dogs *)

        tWedgeLockVerifyTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#8S);
        IF tWedgeLockVerifyTimer.Q THEN
            tWedgeLockVerifyTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bWedgeLockConfirmed         := TRUE;
            iCurrentState               := 90; (* Proceed to Wellbore Pressure Integrity Test *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE_HIGH_PRESSURE_WELLBORE_INTEGRITY_TEST: Bleed hydraulics, verify seal holds well pressure *)
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#03FF; (* Bit 9: Pressure Test Active *)

        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 0.0;
        rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 0.0;

        tSealIntegrityTestTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#10S);

            IF (rRamPosition_m >= (c_rFullSealLockPosition_m - 0.010)) THEN
                bRamSealedAndLocked     := TRUE;
                iCurrentState           := 100; (* Wellhead Successfully Secured *)
            ELSE
                wDiagnosticFaultWord.10 := TRUE; (* Seal Slippage Under Well Pressure Alarm *)
                wAlarmSeverityWord.0    := TRUE; (* Severity: Emergency *)

        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#07FF; (* Bit 10: Wellhead Secured & Isolated *)
        rCmdServoValveSpool_pct         := 0.0;
        rCmdIntensifierBoost_pct        := 0.0;

        tStatePhaseTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3S);

        END_IF;

    950: (* STATE_AUTONOMOUS_DEADMAN_AUTOSHEAR: Fast-acting emergency autonomous shear sequence *)
        wSystemStatusWord               := 16#6950; (* Bit 13: Deadman Autoshear Sequence *)
        bAutoshearArmed                 := TRUE;

        bFastDumpSolenoidCmd            := TRUE;

        IF (rRamPosition_m >= c_rFullSealLockPosition_m) THEN

        bAcousticTxEnable               := TRUE;

                wDiagnosticFaultWord    := 0;
                wAlarmSeverityWord      := 0;

                tSafetyWatchdog(IN := FALSE);

            END_IF;
